notes: This file covers the FRONTEND ONLY (Vite dev server on :5173, single-page app, no router). The product also needs a SEPARATE backend (FastAPI, server/main.py, port 8000) for any real upload/parse/3D flow to work end to end -- without it the page loads but shows a 'not configured' error on upload, because VITE_API_BASE has nothing to talk to. The backend is heavier to stand up: it needs 'pip install -r server/requirements.txt' (torch, opencv, trimesh, PyMuPDF -- a multi-GB install) and runs fine on CPU for the core CAD-PDF vector parser (confirmed on a Mac with no CUDA, per CLAUDE.md), but two optional paths need extras the Mac likely lacks: the photo/scan ML fallback (CubiCasa/TF2DeepFloorplan weights, large downloads) and the photoreal render feature (SDXL + ControlNet, needs a real GPU, explicitly out of scope per docs/DEPLOY-GPU.md). Sutra should treat the backend as 'partly runnable': start it with 'cd server && uvicorn main:app --port 8000' once deps are installed, health check at 'http://localhost:8000/health', but do not attempt the ML/render paths on this hardware. Backend test command: 'cd server && pytest' (real pytest suite under server/tests/, ~520 tests, CPU-only, no network -- duration not measured in this pass per time limit). Do not run 'npm install' or 'pip install' as part of generating this file -- this was a read-only pass.
